title: Front cockpit from above
source: JoyPro's labels, placed on the photo by looking at it (2026-10-31)

labels.note: A glass plate in front of the pilot's eyes that shows speed, height and aiming marks over the view outside.
Keys under the HUD where the pilot types radio frequencies and navigation data.
A screen with buttons around its edge that shows flight and mission pages.
A second screen; the pilot picks its page with the buttons around its edge.
The pilot's right hand flies the jet with this stick between the knees.
The seat that can shoot the pilot out of the aircraft with a parachute in an emergency.
